rationale: The verified source concerns the asymptotic one-step and stable-global errors of a specific additive mixed-precision Runge-Kutta framework. The blind translation instead expresses Minkowski's inequality for arbitrary finite real vectors. It omits the method, operators, coefficients, perturbation model, hypotheses, error orders, stability condition, higher-order remainder, and local/global distinction. Neither statement semantically implies the other in the intended comparison, so the classification is not-faithful-different. Adjudication is requested because the paper leaves its error norm unspecified while the translation selects the Euclidean norm, and the source also contains a perturbation-sign inconsistency, although neither ambiguity alters the decisive mismatch.
